page.content:
Odin's hall of the slain, who will fight at Ragnarok.

How Valhalla connects

  • Location: Asgard — Valhalla stands in Asgard as Odin's hall of the slain.
  • Character: Odin — Odin hosts the einherjar in Valhalla.
  • Faction: Valkyries — Valkyries bring the slain into Valhalla.

What is Valhalla?

Valhalla receives warriors chosen by the Valkyries. They feast and train until Odin leads them out at the last battle.

Key threads lead to Asgard, Odin and Valkyries.
